about_the_game:
Till Checkout Do Us Part is a first-person psychological horror game about Harold, a quiet man who runs the motel with his wife Margaret. To passing unmarried couples, the motel looks like a place to rest. In truth, it’s a trap.

Inspired by classic psychological thrillers of the 60s and 80s, the story is tense, grounded, and told scene by scene without cutscenes. It plays like a narrative-driven walking simulator mixed with psychological horror.

Some guests checks out. Some never leave.

PLOT:

Tired of the city, college student Rachel and her boyfriend Mark head upstate for a quiet getaway. As night falls and fog thickens, they pull off the main highway and find a small roadside motel.

The place is run by a soft-spoken man, Harold, and his wife, Margaret. Grateful for a place to rest, the couple checks in, unaware of the strange and dark fate that awaits them.

FEATURES:

  • Psychological horror thriller inspired by classic films.

  • Multiple endings shaped by how events play out.

  • Cinematic presentation with a vintage film feel.

  • Cozy VHS Aesthetics.

Will you be able to checkout and leave this place?

short_description: A young couple stops for the night at a quiet, roadside motel. It's run by a soft-spoken man, Harold, and his wife, Margaret. As a famous saying goes, some guests can check out anytime they want, but can never leave.
